$comment: pix_gpu_counters_list on the AMD Radeon integrated GPU of a Ryzen 9 7950X3D (driver 32.0.21018.14) with PIX 2606.18-preview, replaying the NVIDIA-captured baseline fixture with IGNORE_INCOMPATIBILITIES, 2026-09-14. Only the 22 D3D counters are exposed.

counters.name: Clipper Primitives In
counters.description: Number of primitives sent to the clipper. Equivalent to the number of times the clipper was executed. This includes additional primitives generated by the Geometry Shader if applicable. If the rasterizer is disabled then this will be 0.

counters.name: Clipper Primitives Out
counters.description: Number of primitives generated by the clipper. Equivalent to the number of primitives that were rendered. This value may be larger or smaller than Clipper Invocations because the clipper may split primitives into multiple primitives and/or cull other primitives entirely.

counters.name: CS Invocations
counters.description: Number of individual Compute Shader threads executed

counters.name: DS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times the Domain Shader was executed

counters.name: GS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times the Geometry Shader was executed

counters.name: GS Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives generated by the Geometry Shader

counters.name: HS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times the Hull Shader was executed

counters.name: IA Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives generated by the Input Assembler

counters.name: IA Vertices
counters.description: Number of vertices generated by the Input Assembler

counters.name: PS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times the Pixel Shader was executed

counters.name: Samples Rejected
counters.description: Difference between the number of resolved samples rendered using the application's default occlusion state, and the number of resolved samples rendered when depth write is disabled.

counters.name: Samples Rendered
counters.description: Number of resolved samples rendered using the application's default depth occlusion state.

counters.name: Samples Submitted
counters.description: Number of resolved samples rendered when depth write is disabled.

counters.name: Stream 0 Output Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives (points, lines, and triangles) written to the stream 0 output buffer.

counters.name: Stream 0 Primitive Storage Needed
counters.description: Number of primitives that would have been written to the stream 0 output buffer if there had been enough space for them all.

counters.name: Stream 1 Output Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives (points, lines, and triangles) written to the stream 1 output buffer.

counters.name: Stream 1 Primitive Storage Needed
counters.description: Number of primitives that would have been written to the stream 1 output buffer if there had been enough space for them all.

counters.name: Stream 2 Output Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives (points, lines, and triangles) written to the stream 2 output buffer.

counters.name: Stream 2 Primitive Storage Needed
counters.description: Number of primitives that would have been written to the stream 2 output buffer if there had been enough space for them all.

counters.name: Stream 3 Output Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives (points, lines, and triangles) written to the stream 3 output buffer.

counters.name: Stream 3 Primitive Storage Needed
counters.description: Number of primitives that would have been written to the stream 3 output buffer if there had been enough space for them all.

counters.name: VS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times the Vertex Shader was executed
